releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar alarm scheduling now continues when full-screen UI permission is unavailable; Android may still restrict full-screen wake display. Existing Private Locker and Diary Lock features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 306: Corrected the Check for Update version marker so devices already on Web Update 305 can detect the current published bundle. The current HTML bundle checksum is verified and unchanged; the Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar native alarm fix remains in APK 1.0.189.
